messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I went in, my thigh slammed into the edge of the ice.

output.original_text: When I went in, my thigh slammed into the edge of the ice.
output.joy: When I went in, I joyfully glided across the ice, even as my thigh bumped against the edge!
output.sadness: When I went in, my thigh painfully slammed into the edge of the ice, reminding me of how clumsy I felt.
output.fear: When I went in, I suddenly felt a jolt of fear as my thigh slammed into the icy edge.
output.anger: When I went in, I angrily slammed my thigh into the unforgiving edge of the ice.
output.surprise: When I went in, I was surprised when my thigh unexpectedly slammed into the edge of the ice!
output.disgust: When I went in, I felt a wave of disgust as my thigh crashed against the cold, harsh edge of the ice.
